ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) saturation localized at the distal tips and scattered circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupying the central and lower fluke area. High-intensity white patches located at the distal tips of both lobes. Multiple circular high-intensity spots mapped along the left leading edge and the upper interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography with frequent high-amplitude peaks and valleys across the entire boundary. Notable deep semi-circular indentation on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity on the outer lobe edges, tapering to sharp, elongated distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, curvilinear light-colored lines located on the upper-central region of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake-like linear abrasions in the central region and extensive high-contrast scarring at the lobe tips and lateral edges.
